description: Nos somos um time de estudantes, de áreas da Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Software e Analise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, que a partir dos conhecimentos aprendidos procura aplicar em soluções para problemas reais
summary: Our project consists of a website that analyzes soil moisture without the use of sensors.
details: A support tool for farmers that analyzes soil moisture without the use of sensors, reducing the costs associated with purchasing and maintaining sensor equipment. The programming languages and technologies used were Java and React. The project is based on existing tools, incorporating improvements to enhance their functionality.
